description: This file manages plugin SDK entry points, providing functions to generate source paths, specifiers, package exports, and distribution artifact paths based on a list of entry points imported from a JSON file.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkEntrySources
methods.description: Generates an object mapping each entry point to its source file path under 'src/plugin-sdk/'.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkSpecifiers
methods.description: Creates an array of module specifiers, customizing the 'index' entry to a root specifier.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkPackageExports
methods.description: Constructs an object mapping package exports to their type definitions and bundled JavaScript files, with special handling for 'index'.

methods.name: listPluginSdkDistArtifacts
methods.description: Returns a list of distribution artifact paths (.js and .d.ts files) for all plugin SDK entries.
